ns2:course.label: Functional Human Anatomy
ns2:course.description: (CSB 234) Studies the essentials of functional human anatomy with special reference to skeletal, muscular, splanchnic, circulatory, and nervous systems. Lecture and laboratory. Prerequisite:MCB 103 and MCB 104, or credit or concurrent registration in MCB 252 and MCB 253, or consent of instructor.
